tx:
Memory strands are primarily used to charge engrams. Handing charged engrams to Orla Fairweather grants about 68,000 Divination experience each at 99, unlocks new benefits and allows the player to reach higher level of prestige in the Memorial to Guthix.
After reaching the first level of prestige, players can also hand memory strands directly for Divination experience to Orla by right-clicking her. Every 1,000 strands exchanged gives the same experience as a medium XP lamp. Players wanting to achieve the most experience per memory strand should continue to prestige rather than turning in extra memory strands for experience. To prestige collect and charge all the engrams, hand them in, then right-click the larger butterfly at the memorial. After this, you have to collect the engrams again in order to prestige them further. Doing so will cost the player the same amounts of energies and strands as the third prestige, but gives more than 11 times the amount of experience, at the cost of extra energies and a few minutes to collect engrams. At level 99 Divination, charging and handing in all twelve engrams will grant about 825,228 experience, using 4,104 strands in the process. By comparison, turning in 4,104 strands directly to Orla would result in about 72,822 experience only. 
The strands also allow direct teleportation to the Memorial to Guthix north-west of the Eagles' Peak lodestone. The teleport can be used even if the player does not currently have any memory strands, as long as they are not in combat. It is an effective teleport to the bank chest in the area—not as close as a ring of duelling or TokKul-Zo, but is unlimited, does not take an equipment slot or inventory space, and has no requirements.…
